theme: Travel day — St. Pete to Toronto for ICGN week.
greeting: Good morning, Dan. The morning is yours in St. Pete, then an afternoon flight carries you to Toronto, where ICGN week opens tomorrow night.

needsAttention.title: Check in for the Toronto flight
needsAttention.detail: Porter PD526 leaves Tampa at 4:20 PM today; the carrier check-in window is open now, and Kiwi has already nudged you to do it.

needsAttention.title: Hold the Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: The full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week has been open since Sep 14. Holiday inventory there sells out — a refundable hold costs nothing and kills the risk in one booking.

needsAttention.title: Arrive at the ICGN dinner with a short list
needsAttention.detail: Tomorrow's ICGN Board Dinner at Lee Restaurant opens the Toronto conference. Worth landing with a few people you want to find, given the board search.

flagged.title: Two roles in your lane
flagged.detail: LinkedIn surfaced a KLA VP of Global Government Affairs and a Meta partnerships lead — both public-affairs adjacent.

flagged.title: NACD New England / Maine team
flagged.detail: Larissa Ravetto sent a Zoom invite for the Nov 30 NACD NE–Maine meeting. Group invite, no reply owed — but it is the Maine director circle worth being in.

flagged.title: Statements posted
flagged.detail: Morgan Stanley and Revolut monthly statements are up; Deloitte tax-services enrollment also opened.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters — Foreign Affairs, Responsible Investor, Italian word of the day, St. Pete locals, and retail.

recipe.title: Chanterelle salad
recipe.why: Chanterelles are at their peak in these last autumn weeks, and a warm mushroom salad is exactly the kind of technique-forward, from-scratch plate that rewards a slow November evening.

tasks.title: Drive the Pathfinder down to St. Pete
Portland house order — bedframe + shower holder

acts.line: Open in St. Pete — room to pack, close loose ends, and check in before you leave.
Porter PD526 lifts off at 4:20 for Toronto, landing around 7:17.
Settle into the Richmond St loft; the ICGN conference week begins tomorrow.
